strategy_roster.name: MA Break Impulse Buy
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,20) > ema(close,30) and ema(close,30) > ema(close,50) and close > ema(close,30) and low <= ema(close,20) and close > open and (close-open) > 1.1 * atr(high,low,close,2)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA filters and breakout touch are retained, with ATR(2) as a proxy for the quiet-range impulse multiplier. Wick limits, quiet-bar state, timeframes, and pip stops are unavailable in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: MomentumSync PSAR RSI ADX Filtered 3-Tier Exit
strategy_roster.notes: Parabolic SAR is unavailable, so an RSI(14) reversal with ADX(14) strength is used; the three-bar exit is represented by a recent RSI bearish cross. SAR parameters and the exact three-tier state machine are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Corrected Average Channel
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20) plus or minus two standard deviations approximates the corrected-average sigma channel because its MA type and period are unspecified. Point-based protection, trailing, and the corrected-average calculation are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Intraday Beta
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(roc(sma(close,10),1),0) and rsi(close,14) < 70 and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: A rising SMA(10) ROC, RSI(14) below 70, and a bullish candle proxy the documented turning-point entry; the inverse slope/RSI conditions exit. The ATR threshold, adaptive trailing stop, and intraday clock have no supplied DSL values.

strategy_roster.name: Stop Loss Take Profit Money
strategy_roster.notes: The documented SMA(14)/SMA(28) bullish crossover and bearish exit are preserved. Money-based profit and loss targets cannot be represented by percentage fields, and the short side is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Fraktrak XonaX Advanced
strategy_roster.notes: A fresh break above the prior five-bar high is the long proxy for a Williams-fractal breakout, with the mirrored low break as exit. Fractal buffers, reverse mode, order state, and pip-based management are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Contrarian DC
strategy_roster.notes: Prior 20-bar Donchian boundaries retain the documented lower-pierce entry and opposite-band exit; 0.3% and 1.7R imply a 0.51% target. The three-candle post-stop pause and short side are stateful and omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Macd Momentum Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: A bearish candle with a rising MACD(12,26,9) histogram is the documented long reversal setup, and the bullish opposite signal exits. The short branch and intraday timeframe are omitted by this long-only roster.

strategy_roster.name: Ring System EA
strategy_roster.notes: Multi-currency triangular baskets, martingale layers, and portfolio PnL targets cannot be expressed on one OHLCV series; bullish candles with average-volume activity are an explicit activity proxy. No deterministic ring signal is available.

strategy_roster.name: DoubleUp2 CCI MACD
strategy_roster.notes: CCI is unavailable, so RSI(8) below 30 is an oversold proxy while MACD(13,33) preserves the documented negative-momentum filter. The CCI threshold, signal period 2, martingale sizing, and point-based target are omitted.
